dedupe_keys.name: geospatial dataset estimating corn and soy inputs for us biofuel plants 2017

description: This dataset estimates the corn and soybean biomass used for corn ethanol and soybean biodiesel at each US biofuel plant. The Zenodo record says county biomass from the 2017 USDA crop census was allocated to plant locations from the US Energy Information Administration by distance from county centroids, giving priority to the larger plant where two competed, and that the estimates matched reported state values within 1.4 percent for corn ethanol in the 11 states with reports. It was published in August 2023 by researchers at Colorado State University and B&D Engineering and Consulting under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as two zipped files of about 0.6 MB. Coverage is the contiguous United States for 2017. Caveats: allocations are modelled from centroids and capacity, not reported purchases. For simulation it gives a county-to-plant feedstock supply network for biofuel supply chain disruption, drought impact and logistics models. Related catalogue records include the Corn Soy Data Layer for the US Midwest and the ORNL Billion-Ton 2016 agricultural baseline.
